name: Natalie Waterman
bio: Clarkson University junior studying biochemistry and biology. EMS Chief (May 2025-present), previously Assistant Chief; also a Residential Advisor and nursing assistant at Canton-Potsdam Hospital. From LaFargeville, NY - high school valedictorian (98.55 average) and Youth Provider of the Year 2023. Known to JD through campus security operations at Clarkson.
public_footprint:
From La Fargeville, NY; Clarkson University Presidential Scholar (Spring 2024) majoring in biomolecular science. Earlier named a WWNY Academic All-Star at LaFargeville Central School, where she was valedictorian-equivalent, student council president, and a volunteer EMT.
Sources: https://clarkson.meritpages.com/stories/Natalie-Waterman-of-La-Fargeville-NY-has-been-named-a-Presidential-Scholar-at-Clarkson-University/133605208; https://gray-wwny-prod.gtv-cdn.com/2023/03/14/academic-all-star-natalie-waterman/
